title: Verify dry-land outlines for Baker, Howland, Jarvis and Palmyra

body:
First raised: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles), during the subject-by-subject review in #405.

## Finding and scope

Baker, Howland, Jarvis and Palmyra currently use Natural Earth 1:10m Admin1 fallback land/atoll polygons. USFWS identity and refuge descriptions show that protected-area boundaries include extensive submerged waters for Baker, Howland and Jarvis; those polygons cannot be substituted for dry-land outlines. Palmyra comprises many islets and lagoons. The exact Natural Earth fallback outlines and small-island completeness remain unverified; this finding does not propose a boundary change.

Subjects: `UMI-5171`, `UMI-5172`, `UMI-5173`, `UMI-5178` only. Preserve each U.S. parent; physical grouping with Kiribati's Line Islands must not merge sovereignty.

The exact source crosswalk is in #405 and PR #1054. The retained scoped Natural Earth Admin1 source extract SHA-256 is `dd3f4a5683c713fd89c00b41748d89771f905ef236feaacb7887818085f3d96e`; source restoration and public-domain terms are pinned there. USFWS pages provide named-unit/protected-area facts but not reusable coastline vertices.

## Acceptance

- Inspect official territorial, refuge, monument and land sources for each exact island/atoll; distinguish physical U.S. land from submerged refuge/monument extents.
- Compare complete named islet/cay and lagoon/land membership against a lawful current land-outline source, preserving neighboring U.S./Kiribati distinctions. Document unresolved pieces without substituting refuge areas or component counts for coverage.
- Retain lawful source bytes or exact restoration instructions, retrieval dates, hashes, licenses, baseline pins, reproducible geometry checks/controls and honest uncertainty.
- Preserve existing IDs, parents, history and release pins; evidence/proposals only, no production changes or imports.
- Link bounded sourced engineering/restoration recommendations where supported and obtain independent exact-head review.

This issue does not approve the U.S. Minor Outlying Islands or South-Central Pacific region.

## Dependency and ownership

This issue depends on completion of #405. Begin only after #405 is merged/closed and its pinned inputs are on main. Own only `data/regional-review/umi-island-land-boundaries-20261005/`.
